程序包 org.bukkit.conversations

类 InactivityConversationCanceller

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.conversations.InactivityConversationCanceller
所有已实现的接口:
Cloneable, ConversationCanceller
public class InactivityConversationCanceller extends Object implements ConversationCanceller
An InactivityConversationCanceller will cancel a Conversation after a period of inactivity by the user. InactivityConversationCanceller 会在用户一段时间不活动后取消 Conversation。

      public ConversationCanceller clone()
      从接口复制的说明: ConversationCanceller

    • cancelling

      protected void cancelling(Conversation conversation)
      Subclasses of InactivityConversationCanceller can override this method to take additional actions when the inactivity timer abandons the conversation. InactivityConversationCanceller 的子类可以重写此方法，在不活动计时器放弃对话时执行额外的操作。
      参数:
      conversation - The conversation being abandoned. 正在被放弃的对话。
